RENDER ONE NEW ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH. Show only the whole head, hair, and top shoulderline, with generous blank margin above hair and on both sides. BULKY LOOSE OPAQUE HIGH TURTLENECK rises to under the jaw and covers the whole neck base; thick abundant ivory knit hides all upper chest and torso forms. No chest, bust, cleavage, neckline, or exposed shoulder, no tight fabric. MANDATORY CAMERA: true geometric 90-degree LEFT PROFILE, camera directly beside left ear. Exactly ONE eye and ONE eyebrow may be visible. The entire far eye, far eyebrow and far eyelash must be hidden behind nasal bridge. Face points screen-left. Not a three-quarter view. Create ONE original sharp realistic premium editorial haircut photograph, NOT a collage, contact sheet, sprite or illustration. The person is a fictional ADULT. HEAD AND SHOULDERS only: complete top of head, all main hair edges, ears and entire haircut silhouette visible, with clear breathing room above the crown and generous margin at both sides. No close crop, no torso emphasis. LOOSE OPAQUE HIGH TURTLENECK LONG-SLEEVED jumper covers neckline and all upper chest, with generous fabric so no chest or torso contour; no low cut, open collar, sleeveless outfit or exposed upper chest. Plain light ivory studio; neutral daylight, sharp face and ALL hair detail, sufficient depth of field; no deliberate blur, bokeh, grain, fog or defocus filter. Natural skin texture, restrained premium salon colour. No text, logos, watermark, jewellery, celebrity likeness, stock or competitor reference. Preserve full source aspect. Render at genuine original native resolution supported by this tool, preferably at least1024pixels long edge. No enlargement or upscaling. Refer to the approved FRONT source. Make a NEW separate photograph of the EXACT SAME fictional adult woman, EXACT SAME haircut, hair colour, fringe, crown and nape geometry, loose opaque high-turtleneck jumper, lighting and studio background. Change only camera viewpoint. Create one original editorial photograph of a fictional adult with a true bob-pixie hybrid. Primary collection: Feathered bixie haircuts. Design: directional lifted | compact squared | full | ear-revealing temple pieces | 3-crown-to-front-proportion. Neutral warm stone setting, natural skin, soft studio daylight, full head/hair/ears/nape visible without crop. Fully covered modest outfit, closed high neckline, long sleeves, no exposed shoulders, chest or back. Portrait 4:5, no words, watermark or logos. Do not substitute an ordinary bob, close pixie or long wolf cut. Render a clearly distinct haircut concept rather than only changing colour or model age. True LEFT SIDE PROFILE, face fully side-on and whole short nape visible, not three-quarter. Never create a collage or crop an existing image; this must be one genuine new angle output file.
Approved real original PNG references supplied: preserve their same fictional adult, exact hair colour and layered geometry, bulky ivory turtleneck knit pattern, studio background and lighting. Sharp full complete silhouette at genuine native resolution, no upscaling.
